proposal.expected_benefit: This will resolve the contradiction between audit status and compliance decisions, ensuring robust control implementation and preventing potential gaps in policy enforcement.
proposal.problem: The mitigations mention 'audit-before-execution' and 'compliance gates' but do not clarify how the audit anchor status is failed or how compliance decisions are being enforced, creating ambiguity in the control implementation.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the mitigations to explicitly define how audit anchor status is determined and how compliance decisions are enforced, ensuring there is no ambiguity in the control implementation.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit and Compliance Enforcement in Mitigations
verification_tests: Check if the updated mitigations clearly define audit anchor status and compliance enforcement mechanisms.
Verify that the defense is sufficient after the clarification of audit and compliance controls.
